rows.text: Following the announcement of Gleisi Hoffmann's departure (afastamento) from the PT presidency, the National Executive Commission met on Friday 7 March 2025; the subtitle says the Executive thanked her for her leadership, and the article says the future minister thanked party members for their support during the eight years she led the PT.

rows.text: At its meeting of Friday 7 March 2025 the National Executive Commission named Humberto Costa, one of the five vice-presidents, for the interim command of the party until the PED 2025 in July; the caption calls him 'presidente interino'.
